question: In the context of financial system, what does the abbreviation SWIFT stand for?

options.text: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication
Society for Worldly Interface Financial Telecommunication
Society for Web Interlinked Financial Transfers

solution:
The correct answer is __**Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• SWIFT is an acronym for the **Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunications** and may also be mentioned as a **CIC code.**
